claim: President Trump said Anthony Fauci said, “This is not a threat. This is not a problem. Don’t worry about it.” when talking about the pandemic
justification: High-confidence evidence (0.95, 0.88) establishes that Dr. Anthony Fauci's actual February 29, 2020 comments emphasized low risk and no need for behavioral changes, but did not include the exact three-sentence phrasing in the claim. While President Trump did publicly attribute similar dismissive statements to Fauci in October 2020, high-confidence evidence (0.30, 0.10) contradicts that this was an accurate verbatim quotation, and multiple fact-checks explicitly label it a misquote. Therefore, the specific claim that Trump used that exact quote is refuted.
